kept.title: Public laneways get salting only, with no snow plowing
kept.detail: This location is described as laneway homes. Under the City report, public laneways are salted within 24 hours after snowfall ends but are not plowed. The report also says snow can end up obstructing access in narrow laneways.

cites.quote: The Council-approved winter maintenance service level for public laneways is salting only, within 24 hours after the end of snowfall, to manage icy conditions; snow plowing is not provided.
creating the potential for snow to be pushed against garages and fences, resulting in damage or obstructed access.

kept.title: Sidewalk clearing begins at 2 cm of snow
kept.detail: The City report says sidewalk clearing begins once snow reaches 2 cm. Crews typically complete a full clearing cycle within approximately 12 hours. So sidewalks to the stops may not be cleared for some time after a snowfall.

cites.quote: City crews typically complete a full sidewalk clearing cycle within approximately 12 hours once accumulation reaches 2 cm.
